proposals.title: Yak fuselage panel seam accents
proposals.change: Add three thin, warm-gray unlit seam strips to the Yak fuselage panel breaks behind the wall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep strips narrow, low-contrast, and at x>=bx+3; use unlit HF shading with no dark metal response.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Behind-wall placement preserves the frozen foreground silhouette and avoids PBR, sun, sky, and black-value changes.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture Loop52 and confirm 11/11 cameras remain usable; YakBeauty gains visible panel segmentation without new dark regions.

proposals.title: Yak wing-root hatch outline
proposals.change: Add one small rounded-rectangle hatch outline at the visible wing root behind the wall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single thin accent with a slightly brighter edge and muted interior; do not enlarge the wing-root volume.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The accent is a tiny behind-wall surface detail and cannot alter the frozen aircraft silhouette or global exposure.
proposals.acceptance_test: Verify the hatch reads at beauty distance while Prop, PropNose, City, Ocean, and Wide remain visually unchanged and usable.

proposals.title: Fuselage access-panel offset
proposals.change: Add one shallow offset border around an existing fuselage access panel behind the wall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a 1-2 pixel projected border in warm gray; keep the panel face mid-value and avoid adding a full hero decal.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Only a small existing-surface border is added beyond x>=bx+3, with no new dark or reflective material.
proposals.acceptance_test: Panel border must be legible in YakBeauty and absent from the frozen foreground overlap; all 11 cameras remain usable.

proposals.title: Bright prop-hub shell
proposals.change: Add a compact bright shell around the prop hub center to separate the hub from the spinner.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a small additive emissive proxy with low intensity and warm ivory color; keep it tightly fitted to the existing hub.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small additive geometry improves hub readability without dark PBR, silhouette expansion, or lighting changes.
proposals.acceptance_test: PropHub and PropNose must show a readable bright center with no bloom washout; Prop, YakBeauty, and the remaining cameras stay usable.

proposals.title: Prop-blade leading-edge shells
proposals.change: Add two narrow bright leading-edge proxy strips to the propeller blades.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place strips close to the blade surfaces, keep emissive intensity restrained, and avoid full-blade glow or radial bloom.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The additive strips are thin, localized, and bright enough to avoid black blade collapse without becoming a hero silhouette change.
proposals.acceptance_test: Blade edges read as separate bright shells in Prop and PropNose; no washout, oversized glow, or usability loss occurs in any camera.

proposals.title: Hub bolt-ring HF dots
proposals.change: Add a small ring of warm-gray high-frequency bolt dots around the prop hub.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a flat unlit HF material and no metallic or roughness-dependent response; limit the ring to eight small dots.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The dots add controlled local frequency with no lighting, dark-metal, or silhouette impact.
proposals.acceptance_test: The hub ring is visible in PropHub at capture resolution and does not create a dark plate or reduce usability in Prop or PropNose.

proposals.title: Cockpit tub rim highlight
proposals.change: Add one narrow warm-gray highlight along the cockpit tub upper rim behind the wall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep the strip inset from the silhouette, with a mid-value base and brighter edge only; avoid black interior fill.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The rim stays behind x>=bx+3 and uses restrained unlit values, improving cockpit structure without changing the aircraft outline.
proposals.acceptance_test: Cockpit shows a distinct tub boundary while YakBeauty and all other frozen views remain 11/11 usable.

proposals.title: Instrument cluster bezel breakup
proposals.change: Add two thin bezel-divider strips to split the instrument cluster into readable gauge groups.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a warm ivory divider and muted gray bezel face; keep all geometry behind the capture wall and avoid reflective glass.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Only two narrow behind-wall dividers are added, with no glass darkening, emissive bloom, or global material changes.
proposals.acceptance_test: Gauge group separation reads in Cockpit and ADS without black instrument collapse; all 11 cameras remain usable.

proposals.title: Instrument needle pinpoints
proposals.change: Add tiny additive emissive pinpoints for the primary gauge needles.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use four sub-pixel-to-small-pixel warm-white pinpoints at low intensity; disable bloom contribution if the capture pipeline permits it.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The proxies are additive, tiny, and localized, preventing black gauge faces without affecting aircraft silhouette or exposure.
proposals.acceptance_test: Needle accents are readable but do not bloom or wash out; Cockpit and ADS stay usable and the other nine cameras remain unchanged.

proposals.title: Throttle quadrant plane break
proposals.change: Add one small bright plane break on the throttle quadrant side of the cockpit tub.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a narrow mid-value raised plane with a brighter top edge; do not add a large control assembly or dark cavity.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The single small plane remains behind the wall and uses unlit HF values that preserve visible separation.
proposals.acceptance_test: The throttle-side structure reads as a distinct plane in Cockpit without new black mass or any camera dropping below Usable.

proposals.title: Glove cuff seam
proposals.change: Add one thin seam and cuff edge to the visible glove hand behind the wall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a light neutral seam over the existing glove value; keep the accent on the cuff and avoid adding fingers or a new silhouette.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The cuff detail is isolated behind the wall and does not touch canopy, aircraft, or lighting materials.
proposals.acceptance_test: Cockpit gains a readable hand-to-sleeve transition with no silhouette growth and remains usable in the frozen recipe.

proposals.title: Glove knuckle plane
proposals.change: Add one small warm-gray HF plane across the glove knuckles to establish hand orientation.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep the patch soft-edged and mid-value, with no dark occlusion layer or extra volume.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single flat HF patch adds local form cues without reflective or dark material behavior and without changing the cockpit silhouette.
proposals.acceptance_test: The hand reads as a separate form in Cockpit while black-area and uniqueness metrics do not regress.

proposals.title: Glove-arm fold accent
proposals.change: Add two short light fold accents along the glove arm near the wrist.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use two discontinuous strips rather than a continuous band; keep them small and behind x>=bx+3.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The discontinuous accents are minimal behind-wall details with no potential for canopy or aircraft silhouette disruption.
proposals.acceptance_test: At least one fold reads in Cockpit without creating a large bright band, black patch, or camera usability regression.

proposals.title: Canopy seal cord cue
proposals.change: Add a thin warm-gray seal cord along the canopy lower inner edge behind the wall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a narrow nonreflective cord with a mid-value base and brighter upper edge; do not use black glass or a full canopy frame.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The cord is a small inner-edge cue placed behind the wall, preserving canopy transparency and avoiding black glass collapse.
proposals.acceptance_test: The canopy boundary reads in Cockpit and YakBeauty while transparency, sky balance, and all 11 usability results remain stable.

proposals.title: Canopy frame corner tabs
proposals.change: Add two tiny bright corner tabs at the visible canopy frame intersections.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use low-intensity additive ivory tabs smaller than the existing frame intersections; no continuous glow or glass material edits.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Tiny additive tabs strengthen canopy edge cues without filling the canopy, darkening glass, or changing the aircraft silhouette materially.
proposals.acceptance_test: Tabs provide two stable edge landmarks with no bloom washout or black-glass collapse; all 11 cameras remain usable.

proposals.title: Canopy latch highlight
proposals.change: Add one small warm-white highlight proxy on the canopy latch behind the wall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep the proxy tightly fitted and dim, with a hard cutoff and no bloom-heavy halo.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The single additive latch cue is localized behind the wall and cannot create a dark canopy region or broad exposure shift.
proposals.acceptance_test: Latch location is visible in Cockpit without a glowing canopy spot, and YakBeauty plus all other cameras remain usable.

proposals.title: Gunner station bulkhead ribs
proposals.change: Add two short vertical rib accents to the gunner station bulkhead behind the wall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use low-profile warm-gray ribs with a one-sided bright edge; keep the bulkhead face mid-value and avoid a full interior stack.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Two small ribs add cockpit depth behind x>=bx+3 with no new dark cavity, reflection, or exterior silhouette change.
proposals.acceptance_test: Bulkhead structure separates in Cockpit while the cockpit remains bright enough and every camera stays usable.

proposals.title: Gunner station trim notch
proposals.change: Add one small bright trim notch to the gunner station side panel.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single trapezoid accent with restrained contrast and no additional panel volume.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single behind-wall trim notch is a controlled local detail and does not affect canopy, aircraft exterior, or exposure.
proposals.acceptance_test: The notch is readable as a manufactured trim cue in Cockpit with no new black block or loss of usability.

proposals.title: Yak fastener micro-cluster
proposals.change: Add a four-point fastener micro-cluster near one existing Yak panel intersection behind the wall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use tiny warm-gray dots with one brighter offset edge; keep cluster size below the panel seam width.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The micro-cluster adds high-frequency authored detail without introducing dark PBR, hero geometry, or foreground overlap.
proposals.acceptance_test: Fasteners are visible only as local panel texture in YakBeauty; protected cameras remain 11/11 usable.

proposals.title: Cockpit anti-glare brow edge
proposals.change: Add one short muted-gray edge accent to the cockpit anti-glare brow behind the wall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a mid-value nonreflective brow with a narrow warm-gray top edge; do not make the brow black or extend it across the full panel.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The short behind-wall edge cue preserves the cockpit value range and avoids any black canopy or instrument collapse.
proposals.acceptance_test: The brow separates from the instrument cluster in Cockpit without darkening the view or reducing any camera below Usable.
